turns.question: Which customer country generated the most non-cancelled order revenue in September 2026, and how much was it in EUR?
turns.answer: Germany (DE) generated the most non-cancelled order revenue in September 2026, at 2,665.50 EUR (revenue over 1 to 30 September 2026). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
